overall_goal: Heat oil in a frying pan and fry the chopped garlic and onions

goals.description: Heat olive oil in a frying pan
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a frying pan, turns on the stove, and measures out spoonfuls of oil to heat in the pan.

goals.description: Add garlic and onions to the pan
goals.rationale: The person transfers the pre-chopped garlic and onions from their bowls into the heated frying pan.

goals.description: Fry and stir the garlic and onions
goals.rationale: The person continuously stirs and separates the garlic and onions in the pan to ensure they cook evenly.
